Enables [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] restrictions for AI armies.\\n\\nAn army becomes restricted when the combined [[col:white]][[img:totowar_cbac_army_supplies]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] cost of its units exceeds the configured limit.\\n\\nEach AI army is given a target size and a target composition, randomly generated within the percentages configured below, so that armies differ from one another.\\n\\nWhen a restricted army is created, recruits units or ends its turn, units are removed until it is back within the limit:\\n- Excess [[col:totowar_cbac_unit_category_hero]]heroes[[/col]] leave the army\\n- Units from the categories exceeding their target are disbanded, choosing the combination that best brings the army back to its target size\\n- If this is not enough, other units are disbanded, as few as possible\\n\\nThe AI is reimbursed for the cost of disbanded units.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.
